subject.title: `infer model run` leaves a persistent session + transcript on every invocation (unbounded growth)

question: Should gateway `infer model run` be ephemeral or hidden from normal session listings by default, or should visible pressure-gated model-run session history remain intended behavior?
rationale: Current main intentionally preserves below-cap model-run probe rows after the related cleanup PR, but this issue asks to remove or hide every one-shot probe session; that changes session lifecycle and client-listing behavior rather than repairing a single missed branch.

options.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
options.body: Change gateway model runs so ordinary one-shot probes do not create client-visible durable sessions by default, while still cleaning legacy `model-run-*` rows.

options.title: Keep Visible Probe History
options.body: Treat pressure-gated 24h cleanup as the intended contract and document that recurring probes can remain visible until cap pressure or manual cleanup.

options.title: Add A Filter Or Flag First
options.body: Keep persistence but add a supported `sessions.list` filter or `infer model run` opt-out after approving the new public API surface.

recommendation.title: Make Probes Ephemeral Or Hidden
recommendation.body: Change gateway model runs so ordinary one-shot probes do not create client-visible durable sessions by default, while still cleaning legacy `model-run-*` rows.

likelyOwner.reason: jalehman most recently carried and merged the related cleanup contract and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether to change that lifecycle policy.
